name: Rock Guitarist Neon Taco Stage
title: Rock Guitarist on Neon Taco Stage – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a big-haired 80s rock guitarist in leather, rim-lit in stage haze against a wall of glowing neon taco signs. Moody and playful.
intro: A hair-metal guitarist caught in side profile, her teased mane backlit into a copper halo, is pure arena-rock drama. Then the backdrop turns out to be dozens of little neon tacos. That collision of serious rock-star posing and a goofy snack pattern is what makes the picture stick, and the purple-orange smoke keeps it looking like a real gig shot.
creates: A square, near-photographic concert image of a woman in a black leather jacket and tight dark pants, guitar slung low, leaning into a riff in profile. Warm amber light rakes in from the left, violet haze drifts behind her, and her face stays mostly in shadow. The dark wall behind is tiled with evenly spaced orange-and-green neon taco outlines that glow softly through the smoke.
works: The phrase "bold rim lighting creating a clean silhouette" does most of the work: it outlines the hair and jacket edges while hiding facial detail, which also satisfies "no visible facial details". "Big teased hair" and "high-waisted tight black pants" pin the look firmly to mid-80s hard rock. Asking for tacos "rendered as subtle graphic shapes" with "neon-accented" edges keeps the pattern decorative instead of literal food, so it reads as a stage backdrop rather than a menu.
tips: Swap the tacos for another motif such as lightning bolts, cassettes or cherries to theme it for a band poster while keeping the neon wallpaper effect.
Add "35mm film grain, pushed Kodak Tri-X colour" or "concert photo from the pit" if you want it to feel more like a found live snapshot.
Push the haze further with "thick dry-ice smoke, single spotlight from above" for a darker, more dramatic silhouette with fewer visible background shapes.
suits: Band flyers, tongue-in-cheek restaurant or taco-night promos, retro rock playlist covers and merch designers who want a silhouette figure that still feels like a live stage photograph.
personalize: Change the guitarist's instrument, outfit or hairstyle and replace the taco pattern with your own brand or food icon, keeping the rim lighting and haze wording intact.

name: Empty Soviet Police Canteen
title: Empty Soviet Police Canteen – 1980s Scene Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a deserted Soviet police canteen: long tables, mismatched chairs, enamel mugs and cold fluorescent light in a graphic novel style.
intro: Rows of identical tables march back into the gloom, each set with the same pair of enamel mugs, and not a single person in sight. The repetition is what makes this scene land: it feels like a place built for shifts and schedules, not comfort. Grey concrete, olive chairs and flat tube lights give it a quietly bleak Cold War mood.
creates: An inked, painted illustration rather than a photo: a wide institutional dining hall with concrete pillars, stained walls and long pale-wood tables on X-shaped legs. Grey and olive metal chairs are pushed in at uneven angles, with white mugs on small trays dotted along each table. Several banks of fluorescent tubes light the space evenly from above, and the palette stays cold and washed-out throughout.
works: "Long worn wooden tables, mismatched metal chairs" gives the model a pattern to repeat, which creates the deep perspective. "Chipped enamel mugs, simple trays, no food visible" adds just enough detail to feel lived-in while keeping the room eerily empty. "Realistic graphic novel style" is why the result has ink outlines instead of photographic texture, and "cold and desaturated color palette" keeps everything in greys and dull greens that suit the Soviet setting.
tips: Remove "graphic novel style" and add "35mm documentary photograph, Svema film stock" if you need a photographic version of the same canteen.
Add a single figure, such as "one tired militsiya officer eating alone at the far table", to give the empty hall a focal point and a story.
Include period props like "faded propaganda poster on the wall, aluminium cutlery, samovar on a side counter" to strengthen the Soviet 1980s reading.
suits: Storyboard artists and graphic novelists building a Soviet-era crime story, tabletop RPG game masters needing location art, and pitch decks for Cold War period dramas.
personalize: Replace "Soviet police canteen" with another institution, such as a factory cafeteria or army mess hall, and keep the tables, mugs and fluorescent-light description.

name: Soviet Police Interrogation Room
title: Soviet Interrogation Room – 1980s Scene Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a bare Soviet interrogation room: metal table, two chairs, barred window and a harsh tube light, drawn in a cold graphic novel style.
intro: One flickering tube light, one table, two chairs and cracked concrete walls: the room is almost nothing, and that is exactly why it feels menacing. The light pools on the tabletop and leaves the corners in murky grey, so your eye goes straight to where the questioning would happen. It is a tight, economical piece of atmosphere.
creates: An illustrated interior in comic-book linework with painted shading, not a photograph. A small grey concrete cell with water-stained, flaking walls, a barred vent-like window high on the left and a single fluorescent fixture hanging from the ceiling. A plain metal table sits at centre with two chairs facing each other, casting hard shadows onto a scuffed floor. Everything is in cold blue-grey tones.
works: "A single metal table at the center, two simple chairs" gives a strong, symmetrical focal point. "Cold fluorescent ceiling light, harsh and uneven" explains the bright cone on the table and the dark edges of the room. "Small barred window high on the wall, almost useless" adds a detail that signals confinement without clutter. Stacking mood words like "oppressive" and "dehumanizing" with "high contrast shadows" pushes the rendering toward bleak noir rather than neutral architecture.
tips: Add "a desk lamp pointed at the empty chair, an ashtray and a manila case file" to make the interrogation purpose unmistakable.
For a photographic version, replace the graphic novel phrase with "grainy 1980s colour film still, tungsten and fluorescent mix".
Try "low camera angle from the doorway" to make the room feel even more claustrophobic and put the viewer in the suspect's position.
suits: Comic and graphic novel creators, true-crime podcast artwork, escape-room or tabletop game designers, and moodboards for Cold War thrillers or other Eastern Bloc period pieces.
personalize: Swap the country and institution, for example an East German Stasi office or a small-town American precinct, while keeping the table, chairs and harsh fluorescent light.

name: Neon Tiger Design App Illustration
title: Neon Tiger Design App Art – 1980s Style Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a vivid digital illustration of a roaring tiger in 80s neon pink, cyan and yellow, framed by floating app windows and palettes.
intro: A snarling tiger rendered in hot orange, electric cyan and magenta fills a tall canvas, while little translucent software windows and swatch panels float around it. Dripping paint streaks and diagonal neon lines give it motion. It mixes retro-futurist colour with a modern interface mock-up, so it feels like splash art for a creative app.
creates: A vertical digital painting, clearly illustration rather than photography. A tiger's head in profile, jaws open and fangs showing, painted with fine fur strokes in orange, teal and pink. Behind it sit gradient fields of magenta, cyan and yellow, bold geometric squares, circles and stripes, and thin blue drips running down. Semi-transparent UI panels with colour pickers and palettes overlap the corners.
works: The prompt never names a subject, just "inspired by the theme", so the model chose the tiger itself; adding your own subject is the biggest lever. "80's palette with vibrant neon colors, gradients, and bold geometric shapes" drives the pink-cyan-yellow scheme and the squares and stripes. "Part of a modern UI design for a graphic design app interface" is why toolbars and swatch windows appear around the artwork.
tips: State a subject explicitly, such as "a roaring tiger" or "a palm-lined coastline", so results stay consistent instead of the model guessing.
Remove the UI interface sentence if you want clean poster art without the floating app windows and palettes.
Add "laser grid horizon, chrome text, VHS scanlines" for a heavier synthwave flavour that leans more obviously toward the decade.
suits: App onboarding screens, design tool marketing, phone wallpapers, Dribbble-style concept shots and anyone who wants a loud synthwave-meets-interface illustration for a tech landing page or launch post.
personalize: Name your own subject in place of the vague "theme" line, such as an animal, car or skyline, and keep the neon palette and app-interface framing.

name: Permed Hair Studio Glamour Portrait
title: Permed Hair Studio Portrait – 1980s Photo Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a mid-80s studio portrait: big perm, blue and pink eyeshadow, magenta lips and a silk blouse against a mottled blue-grey backdrop.
intro: This could pass for a 1985 department-store glamour sitting. The curly perm is huge, the blue-to-pink eyeshadow and blush are laid on without apology, and the mottled blue backdrop is the exact painted canvas every portrait studio owned. Oversized pink-tinted glasses, which the model added on its own, finish the look perfectly.
creates: A realistic head-and-shoulders studio portrait of a woman with a dense, voluminous dark curly perm, large translucent pink frames, bright blue and pink eyeshadow, strong rosy blush and glossy magenta lipstick. She wears an emerald-green silk blouse with a deep V neckline and turns slightly toward the camera. Soft, even studio light shows the hair texture against a blurred blue-grey mottled backdrop.
works: Anchoring the date with "in the style of 1985" and "classic mid-80s style" steers hair, makeup and grading together. Listing the makeup colour by colour, "bright blue and pink eyeshadow, heavy pink blush, and vibrant magenta lipstick", avoids a modern natural-beauty default. "Soft-focus studio backdrop in muted blue and gray tones" recreates the classic painted muslin, and "professional studio lighting that highlights the texture of her hair" keeps the perm crisp.
tips: Specify "no glasses" or "oversized pink-tinted frames" explicitly, since the model may add eyewear on its own and you may want control either way.
Add "soft-focus diffusion filter, slight halation, Kodak Portra" for the dreamy glow typical of glamour-studio portraits of the time.
Change the blouse to "shoulder-padded blazer" or "off-shoulder sweatshirt" to shift from glamour sitting to power-dressing or aerobics-era looks.
suits: Retro makeover content, glamour-shot or yearbook parody posts, costume and makeup artists building 80s references, and casting or look-book decks for period film and TV productions.
personalize: Change the hair colour, blouse colour and eyeshadow shades to suit your subject while keeping the 1985 date, the perm and the blue-grey studio backdrop.

name: Open Plan Office Pitch Scene
title: Office Meeting With Beige PCs – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a cinematic 80s office scene: rows of beige computers, fluorescent ceiling panels and two men in tense talk in the foreground.
intro: The background sells the period: a deep open-plan floor packed with boxy beige monitors, grey desks and low ceiling panels, all softly out of focus. In front, two men square off in conversation, one gesturing mid-point. It has the look of a still from a corporate drama, with the grounded light of a real workplace rather than stylised retro colour.
creates: A photorealistic wide-to-medium shot of a busy office with rows of cream CRT computers, workers at desks and grid fluorescent ceiling lights. In the foreground a grey-haired, bearded man in a fitted black T-shirt and wristwatch talks with his hands to a younger man in a dark suit seen from behind at left. Colours are neutral beige, grey and teal carpet, with natural, even lighting.
works: "Early personal computers and period-accurate decor" is what fills the room with beige CRT workstations. "Wide, photorealistic video shot" and "natural cinematic lighting" produce the shallow depth and film-still framing. Note the result drifts from the text: the prompt asks for a presenting young man and an observing woman, but the image shows two men, and the fitted T-shirt looks modern. Stronger wardrobe and cast wording would fix both.
tips: Add "1980s wardrobe: wide-shouldered suits, loosened ties, big blouses" to stop modern outfits like the fitted T-shirt from creeping in.
If you need the professional woman in frame, describe her position clearly, for example "a woman in a shoulder-padded blazer stands to his right, arms folded".
Include "Kodak Vision 5247 film look, slight grain, warm tungsten desk lamps" to push the image further toward a genuine period feature-film still.
suits: Pitch decks and storyboards for period workplace dramas, tech-history articles, corporate nostalgia posts and video thumbnails about the early personal computer boom and office life.
personalize: Rewrite the two foreground characters and what they are doing, such as a boss scolding an intern, while keeping the office, the early computers and the cinematic lighting.

name: Christmas T-Rex in Fairy Lights
title: Christmas T-Rex Comic Design – 1980s Style Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a retro comic T-Rex in a Santa hat, tangled in colourful Christmas lights beside a tree. Bold outlines, ready for tees and stickers.
intro: A grinning green T-Rex with a Santa hat, wrapped in a knot of coloured bulbs next to a lit-up fir tree, is instantly funny and very printable. Thick black outlines, flat bright colours and a scratchy inked texture give it the feel of an old comic or souvenir tee graphic, and the white background makes it easy to drop onto merchandise.
creates: A standalone cartoon illustration on a plain white background, not a photo. A green T-Rex with a yellow belly and sharp teeth roars cheerfully, a red Santa hat on its head and multicoloured string lights looped around its body and tail. To the right stands a Christmas tree with glowing bulbs and a gold star. Heavy ink lines, hatching and bold red, green, yellow and turquoise colours.
works: "Retro 1980s comic-style illustration" plus "thick outlines" gives the chunky inked look. The fixed palette, "red, green, yellow, turquoise", keeps colours limited and print-friendly. "Bold dynamic composition for t-shirt design" produces a centred, self-contained character, and "transparent background" results in a clean white field you can cut out. The halftone and "distressed retro print style" requests show up lightly as hatching rather than obvious dots.
tips: Ask for "visible Ben-Day halftone dots and faded ink misregistration" if you want the vintage print texture to be much more obvious.
Swap the T-Rex for another creature, such as a stegosaurus or a cat, and keep the lights and Santa hat for a matching holiday series.
Add "limited 4-colour screen print" to reduce colours further, which makes the design cheaper and cleaner to print on real garments.
suits: Print-on-demand shirt sellers, holiday sticker packs, ugly-sweater party invitations, kids' Christmas cards, and small shops building a playful retro-comic merch line for the festive season.
personalize: Replace the dinosaur and the Christmas props with your own character and holiday, for example a mummy with Halloween pumpkins, keeping the comic outlines and fixed palette.

name: Soviet Police Station With Lada
title: Soviet Police Station With Lada – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a grey Soviet police station under an overcast sky, a white Lada parked out front, in a cold, desaturated, bureaucratic mood.
intro: A squat grey concrete block with a flat entrance canopy, antenna masts on the roof and a lone white Lada saloon out front: the scene is instantly recognisable as late-Soviet provincial architecture. The low, cloudy sky and bare trees make everything feel chilly and ordinary, which is exactly the understated bureaucratic mood the prompt goes for.
creates: A semi-realistic, lightly illustrated exterior view that sits between photo and graphic novel. A two-storey grey concrete police station with rows of small windows, a green sign over a porch entrance and wide concrete steps with railings. A boxy white Lada is parked on the cracked forecourt. Leafless shrubs, a pale overcast sky and a muted, almost monochrome palette complete the scene.
works: "Grey concrete building, utilitarian and anonymous" produces the blocky, featureless facade. "A modest parked car in front of the entrance" is interpreted as a classic Lada, which does a lot to place the scene in the USSR. "Overcast sky, cold daylight" flattens shadows and cools colour, and "cold and desaturated color palette" strips out almost everything but grey and faded green, giving the image its drab, official tone.
tips: Name the car directly, "white VAZ-2106 Zhiguli with militsiya markings", to guarantee the vehicle and add a clear police cue.
Add "light snow on the steps, slush on the asphalt" for a more wintry, bleak version of the same building.
For a more photographic look, remove the graphic novel phrase and request "faded Orwo colour film, 35mm, slight vignetting".
suits: Establishing shots for Soviet-era crime comics or films, history channel thumbnails, Eastern Bloc architecture moodboards and world-building art for Cold War strategy or adventure games.
personalize: Change "Soviet police station" to another public building such as a post office or clinic, and name a different period car, keeping the overcast light and desaturated palette.

name: Sapphire Anime Girl City Night
title: Blue-Haired Retro Anime Girl – 1980s Style Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a retro-style anime heroine with flowing blue hair, sapphire jewellery and a purple gown, smiling against a starry neon city skyline.
intro: Long waves of blue hair blowing across a violet evening sky, sparkling star glints and soft neon signs below give this the dreamy feel of classic magical-girl anime. The palette sticks almost entirely to blues and purples, so the diamond earrings and necklace pop as little points of light. Her open, cheerful smile keeps it warm rather than moody.
creates: A cel-shaded anime illustration, not a photograph. A young woman with very long wavy blue hair, large shining blue eyes and diamond drop earrings and necklace smiles toward the viewer. She wears a long-sleeved royal-blue dress with a sweetheart neckline. Behind her, city towers with pink and cyan neon edges rise into a deep indigo sky scattered with four-pointed stars.
works: "1980s anime vibe" pulls the rendering toward clean cel shading, thick hair shapes and glossy highlights typical of retro TV anime. Repeating blue, "blue long wavy hair", "blue diamond eyes", "blue purple dress", locks in a near-monochrome palette. "Blue purple evening sky, shiny stars" gives the sparkle effects, and "modern city" adds the neon skyline that ties the look to city-pop artwork.
tips: Add "VHS screenshot, slight chromatic aberration, soft film grain" to make it look like a frame grabbed from an old tape.
Specify "city pop album cover composition" for more negative space and a skyline that frames her like a record sleeve.
Change the gem colour and matching palette, such as ruby and crimson, to create a set of themed character variations.
suits: City pop and lo-fi playlist covers, VTuber or character concept references, phone wallpapers, and fans making retro magical-girl fan art, avatars or profile pictures with a nostalgic feel.
personalize: Swap the hair colour, gemstone and dress colour as one matched set and change "modern city" to your own backdrop, keeping the anime-era wording.

name: Night Ride in Black Buick Regal
title: Night Ride in a Black Buick Regal – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for an illustrated night scene of two serious men in a black Buick Regal, the driver smoking, city lights blurred behind the windshield.
intro: The glossy black hood of a Buick Regal fills the lower frame, rain-slick reflections of orange streetlights sliding across it, while two men sit inside with hard, unreadable expressions. A curl of cigarette smoke rises from the driver's window. It has the feel of a crime-game loading screen or a graphic novel panel set on a late-80s city street.
creates: A painted, comic-style illustration rather than a photograph. Viewed from the front three-quarter angle, a black Buick Regal with a bulging hood sits at night. The driver wears a green, orange and white windbreaker and bandana, cigarette in hand, gripping the wheel. The passenger, younger, wears a white shirt and tie. Warm bokeh streetlights and a green dashboard glow light their faces.
works: Naming a specific car, "black 1980s Buick regal", gives the model a recognisable boxy G-body silhouette that instantly dates the scene. "At night" plus the unspoken urban setting produce the orange bokeh behind the glass. "Is smoking a cigarette" adds the smoke wisp, and "both men have a serious look on their face" sets the tense, crime-drama mood. The character reference tags in the original prompt control who appears, so replace them with your own descriptions.
tips: Describe each person in words, such as age, clothing and hairstyle, since the character tags will not carry over outside their original setup.
Add "35mm film still, grainy, sodium vapour streetlights" if you want a photographic version instead of the illustrated rendering.
Include "Grand National trim, T-top roof, wet street reflections" to push the car detail and the late-80s atmosphere further.
suits: Hip-hop mixtape and single covers, crime story or podcast artwork, game concept art, and storyboards for period dramas set on the streets of 80s urban America after dark.
personalize: Replace the two tagged characters with written descriptions of your own people and swap the Buick Regal for another period car, keeping the night setting and serious mood.

name: Moonlit Dark Fantasy Cottage
title: Moonlit Dark Fantasy Cottage – 1980s Style Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a painted dark fairy-tale night: a huge grey-blue moon over a witchy cottage, stone bridge and glowing jack-o'-lanterns.
intro: A swollen grey-blue moon hangs over black pines while a crooked cottage glows orange from every window. The only other warm spots are carved pumpkins scattered along a stream, so the eye moves from house to bridge to lanterns. It recalls the painted covers of 80s fantasy paperbacks and storybooks: spooky, but inviting enough to want to walk in.
creates: A wide, detailed fantasy painting, not a photograph. A full moon sits among swirling clouds above a dark forest of gnarled trees and pines. On the left, a steep-roofed cottage with lit windows and a smoking chimney sits on a rocky bank. A small stone bridge crosses a moonlit stream, and jack-o'-lanterns glow along the path and shore. The palette is deep navy with orange accents.
works: The prompt is very short, so most detail comes from the model. "Deep blue night sky" and "chilling, grayish-blue moon" set the cold palette and the dominant moon. "1980s dark fantasy fairy tale" nudges the model toward painted book-cover illustration, which is why a cottage, winding stream and pumpkins appear although none were named. The period tag here signals an art style more than a photographic era.
tips: Name the scene elements you want, such as a cottage, bridge or castle, because the short prompt leaves composition largely to chance.
Add "airbrushed paperback cover painting, visible brushwork, slight print grain" to lean harder into the vintage fantasy-art feel.
Remove the pumpkins by adding "no jack-o'-lanterns" if you want a timeless fairy-tale night rather than a Halloween scene.
suits: Halloween posters and social posts, fantasy book cover mock-ups, storytelling podcasts, spooky playlist art and atmospheric background plates for tabletop adventure handouts and campaign maps.
personalize: Add your own focal subject, such as a castle, a lone rider or a witch's tower, beneath the grey-blue moon while keeping the colour wording and dark fairy-tale tag.

name: Faded Classroom Class Picture
title: Faded Classroom Group Photo – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a faded school group photo: fifteen students in striped polos and jeans, posed in two rows before a blackboard in a bright classroom.
intro: It looks like a print pulled from a shoebox: a bright, slightly bleached classroom, a blackboard with faint chalk, and a group of teenagers in striped polos and high-waisted jeans lined up for the camera. Small quirks, like the kid in sunglasses and the boy with a stuck-on-looking moustache, give it the goofy candour of real class photos.
creates: A realistic, washed-out colour photograph of fifteen young people in a white classroom. Eight sit on a glossy tiled floor in front, seven stand behind against a large dark blackboard. Outfits include striped and solid polo shirts, a navy jacket, jeans and chinos, with curly and feathered hair. Big windows at left flood the room with daylight; a red fire extinguisher hangs at right.
works: "The image is slightly faded, indicating it is an older photograph" is what lifts the blacks and washes the colours. Precise staging, "three rows" with "eight people kneeling or sitting", gives the posed class-photo layout. Named wardrobe, "striped shirts, polo shirts, and jackets", dates the clothing, and small details like "one man in the front row is wearing sunglasses" and the "fire extinguisher" make it feel observed rather than generated.
tips: Add "on-camera flash, slight red-eye, rounded print corners" to make it feel even more like an amateur snapshot from a family album.
Tighten the date to "1984" instead of "1980s or 1990s" so hair and clothes do not drift toward early-90s styles.
Change the setting to a gym or school steps and add "class of '86 banner" for a reunion invitation or yearbook-themed variant.
suits: School reunion invitations, nostalgic social posts, yearbook-themed designs, coming-of-age film pitch decks and anyone recreating an old class picture with a believable, faded retro feel.
personalize: Adjust the group size, clothing details and classroom props, such as the blackboard writing, to match your own school while keeping the faded-print description.

name: Red Silk Dress on Estate Terrace
title: Red Silk Dress on Estate Terrace – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a quiet-luxury film portrait: a woman in red silk, tortoiseshell shades and a silk scarf on a sunlit marble estate terrace.
intro: Deep crimson silk against sun-bleached marble and cream stone balustrades makes this frame glow. The woman's tortoiseshell sunglasses, patterned scarf and neat updo feel like old-money leisure rather than flashy fashion, and the rounded film border and soft grain suggest a scanned slide. It captures the relaxed jet-set glamour of early-80s society photography.
creates: A vertical, film-style fashion portrait. A dark-haired woman in a long-sleeved red satin wrap dress stands on a gleaming marble terrace, wearing oversized tortoiseshell sunglasses and a knotted cream-and-rust silk scarf. Behind her rises a pale neoclassical mansion with columns, arched windows and slate roofs, with a stone balustrade and gardens at right. Warm afternoon sun, creamy highlights, visible grain and a dark film-frame edge.
works: Referencing "quiet luxury" and "early 1980s" society imagery points the model at estate settings and restrained styling. "Framed through a 50mm lens" keeps perspective natural, while "visible 35mm grain" and "cream-toned highlights" with "deep, muted shadows reminiscent of Kodachrome" give the warm slide-film colour. The textile detail, "sumptuous red silk dress" and "Hermès silk scarf", makes the fabric sheen the star of the image.
tips: Add "poolside, cocktail glass, striped cabana" to move the scene toward classic resort-leisure photography of the period.
Remove the film-frame border by adding "full-bleed image, no film edges" if you need a clean crop for print layouts.
Try "late afternoon backlight, lens flare, slight overexposure" for a hazier, more sun-drenched version of the same terrace.
suits: Luxury fashion moodboards, boutique hotel and resort marketing, editorial Instagram grids, vintage lookbooks and pitch decks for period films about wealthy families and their summer estates.
personalize: Change the dress colour and fabric, the accessories and the villa setting, such as a Riviera yacht deck, keeping the 50mm, Kodachrome and grain wording.

name: Drag Queen on Neon Street
title: Drag Queen on a Neon Street – 1980s Photo Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a glam 80s street portrait: a red-haired drag queen in a bold geometric suit, posing on a wet neon-lit city street at dusk.
intro: A riot of pink, teal, yellow and black geometric print, a ruffled white shirt and gold chains make the outfit loud enough to compete with the signs behind her, and it does. Long crimson hair flipped with one hand, a hand on her hip and wet asphalt catching neon reflections turn a city street into a runway.
creates: A photorealistic full-length street portrait at dusk. A drag queen with long, voluminous dark-red hair, bold red lips and dramatic eye makeup stands mid-road in a sharply tailored suit covered in a colourful geometric pattern, with a ruffled jabot and layered gold jewellery. Neon signs, taxis and headlights blur behind her, and pink, blue and gold reflections streak across the rain-soaked pavement.
works: "Neon-lit city street at dusk" with "vivid streetlights cast colorful reflections off the wet pavement" is the core recipe for the glowing, rain-slick background. "80s Armani ensemble that fuses bold colors and sharp lines" becomes the angular printed suit. The pose is spelled out, "one hand on her hip, the other playfully flipping her hair", which gives a confident, dynamic stance, and "photorealistic" keeps it a photo rather than an illustration.
tips: Add "shoulder pads, pleated trousers, slightly oversized tailoring" if you want the suit silhouette to read more specifically as mid-80s.
Include "shot on 35mm with flash, slight motion blur in background" for a gritty paparazzi-style street snapshot instead of a polished editorial.
Swap "dusk" for "after midnight" and add "steam rising from manholes" for a moodier, darker nightlife version.
suits: Drag and nightlife event posters, Pride campaign visuals, fashion editorial moodboards, retro club night promos and social posts celebrating the camp, colour and glamour of the 80s.
personalize: Change the performer's hair colour, makeup and suit pattern, and name your own city street, keeping the wet pavement and neon reflection wording.

name: Nagel-Style Drag Queen Tropical Pinup
title: Nagel-Style Tropical Drag Pinup – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a flat, Nagel-inspired illustration of a drag queen with floor-length black hair and a magenta blouse before a tropical sunset.
intro: Flat colour blocks, clean outlines and a coral-to-gold sunset behind stylised palms give this the unmistakable poster-art feel of early-80s pinup illustration. The figure's floor-length black hair makes a dramatic vertical line, and the magenta blouse against teal foliage is a punchy, very period colour pairing. It is graphic, confident and poster-ready.
creates: A full-length vector-style illustration on a cream border, not a photograph, despite the prompt asking for one. A muscular drag queen with extremely long straight black hair stands hand on hip, wearing an open magenta button-up blouse, a navy pencil mini skirt and black stilettos. Behind her, a rectangle panel shows a pink-orange sunset, palm trees and dark green tropical leaves in flat, layered shapes.
works: "Patrick Nagel style" overrides everything else and is why you get flat, graphic illustration even though the prompt starts with "Photograph of". That reference brings the pale skin shading, sharp contours and limited palette. "Magenta button up blouse" and "midnight blue mini skirt" set the colour pairing, "ridiculously long black hair" becomes the dramatic hair column, and "tropical background" adds the Miami-style sunset panel.
tips: Remove "Photograph" and "professional photo" to avoid conflicting instructions, since the Nagel reference clearly wins anyway.
For a real photo, drop the Nagel reference and add "Miami beach at sunset, 35mm Fujicolor, flash fill" while keeping the outfit wording.
Add "limited palette, screen-printed poster, cream paper texture" to make it look even more like a vintage salon art print.
suits: Poster and art-print sellers, drag performer promo art, salon or nail bar decor, retro Miami-themed event flyers and fans of flat, graphic 80s pinup illustration styles.
personalize: Change the outfit colours, hair and tropical backdrop to your own subject and setting, keeping the Nagel style reference and the flat sunset panel.

name: Leopard Halter Fashion Doll
title: Retro Fashion Doll in Leopard Print – 1980s Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a photoreal fashion doll in a leopard halter, studded band and denim mini, with a big blowout, heavy makeup and chunky platform heels.
intro: The doll is styled like a mall-rat glamour shot: a big glossy blowout, frosty blue eyeshadow and lilac lips, a leopard halter with a studded brown band and a frayed denim mini. Boxed dolls blurred behind her and a cartoon-print cloth underfoot make it feel like a collector's toy photo, which is part of its charm.
creates: A realistic product-style photograph of a fashion doll with warm brown skin, oversized head and eyes, and voluminous black hair. She wears a leopard-print halter top with a rhinestone-studded brown under-bust band, a short denim skirt and chunky tan platform heels. Pink doll boxes stand out of focus behind her, and she stands on a cream fabric printed with small doll illustrations. Soft, even indoor light.
works: Naming a specific doll line and asking for skin tone to match the "Sasha" doll gives the model the proportions and complexion. "Leopard print halter top with some rhinestones on a thick brow band" becomes the studded band detail. "80s like blow out" drives the big, lifted hair, and "heavy makeup" produces the frosted eyeshadow. Note the doll itself is a 2000s toy, so this is a retro-dressed toy shot, not a period photo.
tips: Add "neon pink leg warmers, oversized hoop earrings, side ponytail" to make the styling read more clearly as 80s rather than early 2000s.
Specify "plain seamless backdrop" if you want to lose the doll boxes and patterned cloth for a cleaner product shot.
Include "macro lens, shallow depth of field, soft box lighting" for a sharper collector-catalogue look with creamy background blur.
suits: Doll collectors and customisers, toy restyling content, fashion design mood studies, nostalgic TikTok or Instagram posts and anyone sketching retro outfits on a miniature model.
personalize: Swap the outfit pieces, hair style and skin tone to design your own doll look, keeping the retro blowout and heavy makeup wording.

name: Veiled Mage on Fiery Mountain
title: Veiled Mage With Rainbow Halo – 1980s Style Prompt
description: Copy this prompt for a cosmic painting of a hooded, faceless mage with a golden staff on a burning peak, ringed by a rainbow under an indigo sky.
intro: A faceless, hooded figure stands on a rocky summit as flames lick the edges and a luminous rainbow ring circles behind them like a halo. The combination of sacred-icon composition, a golden sunburst staff and a neon-tinged cosmic sky echoes airbrushed 80s fantasy art and metal album covers. It is mysterious and striking without a single visible face.
creates: A square digital painting, not a photograph. A robed figure in deep blue with a dark void where the face should be holds a tall golden staff topped with a radiant ornament. Long violet fabric streams sideways in the wind. They stand on a dark rock peak surrounded by orange flames, backed by a large circular rainbow halo, a starry indigo sky and pink-edged clouds.
works: "Veiled saint or mage" plus "religious iconography" produces the icon-like frontal pose and the halo. "Rainbow leading away" was interpreted as a ring behind the figure, which actually strengthens the saintly reading. "Fiery mountain" gives the flame-edged summit, and "retro 80s aesthetic, cosmic" with "neon colors, deep indigo sky" sets the glowing magenta, orange and indigo palette typical of synthwave-flavoured fantasy painting.
tips: If you want the rainbow to trail off as a path, write "a rainbow bridge stretching from the summit into the distance" rather than "leading away".
Add "airbrushed 1980s fantasy paperback cover, visible grain" to make it feel more like vintage painted cover art than a modern render.
Reveal a face by replacing "veiled" with "hooded, glowing eyes" or a described face, depending on how mysterious you want the character.
suits: Metal and synthwave album covers, tarot and oracle card designs, fantasy RPG character art, spiritual or meditation channel thumbnails and large-format poster prints for fantasy fans.
personalize: Change the figure, their held object and the landscape, such as a knight with a sword on an icy peak, while keeping the rainbow halo and neon indigo palette.
